facts.value: Online Bachelor of Science in Engineering in Electrical Engineering

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information
Programme Information
Programme Information

facts.value: In this online EE degree, you’ll complete a mix of foundational and advanced courses designed to build expertise in electrical and electronic systems, including circuits, signal processing, embedded systems and energy systems used in power systems, communications and advanced electronic technologies.

metadata.chunk_title: Online electrical engineering courses

facts.value: Over four years, you’ll progress from core engineering principles to specialized topics, culminating in a two-semester, team-based capstone design project.

metadata.chunk_title: Online electrical engineering courses

facts.value: Elective offerings include machine learning applied directly to hardware platforms — reinforcing the AI and embedded systems focus the program emphasizes.

metadata.chunk_title: Online electrical engineering courses

facts.value: Courses are delivered in a flexible online format, with 7.5-week sessions in your first two years. Upper-division courses follow a 15-week format, giving you more time to dive deeper into complex engineering concepts.
